answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, making pseudonymous participation costly. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting histories, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss, rapidly exhausting a sybil operator’s escrow. Asymmetric depreciation further limits recovery, whether nodes gather at a ferrous summit or coordinate through a remote wharf.
